name: Diffusion Tensor Reconstruction via Spherical Harmonics
aliases: Least square fitting of gradient magnitudes
definition: Reconstruction of higher order symmetric second order tensors Di0...ir of order r by solving the Stejskal-Tanner formula using least square fit of measured gradient magnitudes to a spherical harmonic basis.
summary: This method reconstructs higher-order tensors from DTI data using spherical harmonics to model complex multi-fiber diffusion patterns, unlike standard DTI which yields only single tensors per voxel.
